implementationStatusBasis: No implementation evidence is attributed to this requirement. kemiller2002/indy-init is the planning repository and contains no application source at the source commit (validation check V10). Rehearsal results are not carried forward as evidence: Rehearsal 2's ledger is INVALID under tools/validate-acceptance-ledger.py and Rehearsal 3 is NOT ACCEPTED (docs/OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-10-24.md, Consequences).

freshness: bound to the exact application source commit SHA under test (and the deployed SHA for deployed checks, G9)
bound to the requirements baseline id and its sha256 used by the run (RDP-001)
bound to the dependency lock digest of the run (VER-004, DEP-CURRENT-006)
bound to the interface manifest SHA when the requirement crosses a boundary (G2)
invalidatedBy: any change to the application source commit under test
baseline re-pin, or drift reported by the preservation gate (RDP-001, RDP-004)
any change to the dependency lock (VER-004)
evidence produced by an unreleased or unregistered tool build (VER-005)
a digest, revision or id that does not match the host observation (dokimos completion verify)
verificationDefaults.evidenceReuse: Reuse is permitted only when Dokimos reports the evidence Reusable:true with matching id, SHA-256 digest and immutable revision, and no invalidatedBy condition has occurred since; otherwise the check is re-run. Evidence from earlier rehearsals is never reused for this run.

assumptions: Each owner role (domain, ui, persistence, integration, coordinator, reviewer) runs in its own lane; operator and upstream lanes do not constrain concurrency.
Every task is one unit step: no task duration is known from evidence, so steps order work and do not estimate time.
One CI run per merged task (implementation, checkpoint and verification kinds) is the planned upper bound.
Ready tasks are started longest-remaining-chain first, so the critical path is never delayed by a shorter branch.
operatorDecisionsRequired: Approve parallel agent fan-out: REHEARSAL-004-WRITE-PATH-PLAN R4-03 and AR-021 prefer one continuous lead agent (finding F-007).

assumptions: All implementation roles are held by one continuous lead agent (R4-03, AR-021); the fresh reviewer is a separate lane used at T30 and T33 only.
Every task is one unit step: no task duration is known from evidence.
CI is batched: a CI run is planned at each integration checkpoint and verification task, not per task (ADRP-010, AR-022: batching may not suppress a required check).
Repository reads are limited to the compiled package plus the files a task names; the package replaces rediscovery of decisions and contracts.
